status: Frozen after corpus replay/AST screening and before corpus-wide per-request mutation evaluation
selection: All candidates emitted by the frozen screen: single non-negated bare deny expression, same-package partial-set deny rule, CSV expected label uniquely deny, literal JSON input binding, original policy check success, and native suite execution. Preserve 148 raw AST occurrences and their 83 unique suite/name/input units; do not pick cases by subsequent outcomes.
mutation_eligibility: Exactly one AST default allow declaration with boolean false, and exactly one anchored source default allow=false or :=false declaration. Replace only that false token with true in a separate byte copy. Compile mutant; failures/ineligible variants retained. No other source repair or compatibility switch.
native_checks: For every unique eligible request, evaluate explicit allow and deny values under original and mutant using query stdin. Run the unchanged named test group in original and mutant; filter native outputs by the exact original name after native duplicate-name #NN normalization. All members of the matching group must pass for a group-level passing classification; mixed duplicate groups remain distinct/ambiguous. Run each available candidate suite against the mutant as well, retaining whether the whole suite already failed originally.
primary_mechanistic_witness: Original allow is boolean false and deny is empty set; mutant allow is boolean true and deny is empty set; all matching native named-test-group instances pass under both. This confirms failure of that assertion group to distinguish the explicit signals for the tested input. It does not authenticate intended application authorization.
secondary_observations: Report nonempty deny signals, unchanged allow values, undefined/nonboolean outputs, parse/evaluation/test errors, ineligible mutations and full-suite failures. Whole-suite mutant escape is reported only where the original full suite passed and the mutant full suite passes.
runtime_and_isolation: Same verified official OPA v1.22.4, private bubblewrap filesystem/network, read-only selected inputs and binary, cleared environment, two concurrent workers at most, 10-second native test timeout and 15-second outer command timeout. Fresh staging in one WSL process; outputs streamed to compressed per-command records on Windows to avoid prior disk exhaustion.
integrity: Record candidate inventory hash, original and mutant policy hashes, extracted-input identities and all command results. Do not alter the acquired 850 files or previously recorded baseline results. Exact token-only mutation is checked by byte equality with the prescribed replacement.
limits: Mechanism-directed follow-up after one exploratory case, not blinded discovery. Counts conditional on a supported static screen; no prevalence outside this artifact, application exploitation, natural-intent accuracy, new mutation-testing algorithm or correction to published aggregate scores. Duplicate occurrences are not independent cases. No external-review prerequisite for a preprint.
